svg.title: Yuri Gagarin
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and interpretive screen colors. White canvas with a loose dark closed head-like contour and small almond loop. Thin filled vector outlines simplify brush variation; support retained, texture omitted. This remains a schematic of the observed painting, not a tracing of every brushstroke. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/154131; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
